issue.description: Implement the notifier decided in ADR-0006 (docs/plan.md, section 'ADR-0006'; full copy in docs/adrs/, ADR number 0006). Add ~/.ccdash/config.yaml (notify.enabled bool default false, notify.webhook_url string) and a new internal/notify/ package. In the existing refresh loop, only the lease-holding leader (internal/metrics/cache.go TryAcquireLease) diffs prior vs current HookSession status per session; on a transition into waiting/asking that persists >~15s, POST a compact JSON payload (session name, project dir, idle duration only — no token/cost data) to notify.webhook_url. issue.description: internal/updater/updater.go (CheckForUpdate) is only invoked when the user presses 'u'. Given ccdash ships real bug fixes across point releases (e.g. 1.0.2 fixed sessions stuck WORKING when actually blocked on human input — a correctness bug, not cosmetic), users on stale binaries silently keep the old broken behavior. On startup, do one non-blocking CheckForUpdate call and show a small dismissible banner/status-bar note if a newer version exists (no auto-install, matches existing opt-in self-update UX). Keep it non-blocking so offline/no-network startup is unaffected (mirror existing error handling in CheckForUpdate).
issue.notes:
Feature verification: Auto-check-for-update on startup is ALREADY FULLY IMPLEMENTED.

Current behavior (verified in code):
1. Init() calls checkForUpdates() on startup (dashboard.go:183)
2. Updates checked every 2s via tick (dashboard.go:245)
3. Status bar shows banner: '⬆ vX.X.X available! Press u to update' (dashboard.go:1899-1900)
4. Non-blocking: Uses async tea.Cmd pattern, offline/no-network handled gracefully

The task premise that 'CheckForUpdate is only invoked when user presses u' is incorrect. The 'u' key triggers performUpdate() (download/install), not the version check.

Added in commit ee03495 (2025-11-27) with full self-update feature.

No implementation work needed - feature exists and works as specified.
issue.title: Auto-check-for-update banner on startup (currently manual-only via 'u')
